history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Asian man wearing a black full-face motorcycle helmet with a white logo, a black leather jacket over a white collared shirt, and dark pants is posed on a motorcycle. He is partially obscuring his face with his right hand. The background is a concrete wall covered in vibrant, abstract graffiti art featuring bold lines, geometric shapes, and organic forms in shades of blue, pink, red, yellow, and black. The lighting is dim and atmospheric, suggesting it is nighttime or a dimly lit underpass, with some light illuminating the graffiti and highlighting the man and his motorcycle. The overall mood is edgy and urban, with a hint of mystery due to the helmet and the dimly lit environment. The image has a slightly grainy texture, common in low-light photography. The motorcycle appears to be a dark color, possibly black, with some visible chrome accents and a "YAMAHA" logo on the fuel tank.
